summary: Feed s137_double is degraded: 2 faults detected. Required VLANs 10,20 are missing (100% untagged) and encrypted share 94.7% exceeds NDR tolerance of 90%, limiting payload inspection and VLAN-aware detection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN/TAP path is stripping 802.1Q tags (VLAN pop/strip enabled) or forwarding only native VLAN as untagged, so required VLANs 10 and 20 never arrive at the NDR despite being required by tool profile.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot segment, filter or correlate traffic by VLAN/tenant; all VLAN-specific detections and policies for VLANs 10,20 fail, creating complete blind spots for segmentation violations and lateral movement.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve 802.1Q tags end-to-end from TAP through packet broker to NDR so VLANs 10,20 are visible for correct classification and detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: 94.7% of bytes are encrypted (TLS) with no prior decryption; traffic mix inherently exceeds the NDR's 90% encrypted tolerance and the NDR needs full payload.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR with needs_full_payload=true is blind to payload content and must rely on metadata/flow analysis only, significantly reducing detection coverage for encrypted C2, exfiltration and exploit payloads.

recommended_fix.why: Provide cleartext copy via dedicated SSL visibility/decryption appliance before the packet broker forwards to NDR, or explicitly tune NDR to metadata-only detection if decryption is not permitted.
